meta.title: VIP Workflows — pull request preview
meta.description: Installs the VIP Workflows build from a pull request, seeds demo content and role users, and lands on the Workflows dashboard.
meta.author: vip-workflows

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

foreach ( array( 'editor', 'author', 'contributor' ) as $role ) {
	if ( username_exists( $role ) ) {
		continue;
	}
	wp_insert_user(
		array(
			'user_login'   => $role,
			'user_pass'    => 'password',
			'user_email'   => $role . '@example.test',
			'display_name' => ucfirst( $role ) . ' User',
			'role'         => $role,
		)
	);
}
